KnowledgeIds.title: Knowledge IDs
KnowledgeIds.description: Comma-separated folder (container) IDs when entire folders are selected

FilePaths.title: File Paths
FilePaths.description: Comma-separated paths required for summarization: one per selected file (filePath or display name), matching LWC getKnowledgeSpaceFileSummary additionalFilter.filepaths

KnowledgeSpaceSearchIndexId.title: Knowledge Space Search Index ID
KnowledgeSpaceSearchIndexId.description: Personal knowledge search index id for the notebook

SInames.title: SI Names
SInames.description: Comma-separated enterprise search index developer names (optional context)

SummarizeSegmentsJson.title: Summarize segments JSON
SummarizeSegmentsJson.description: JSON array of segments: each object has kind (personal|enterprise), searchIndexName, containerIds (string array), filePaths (string array). When provided, the invocable summarizes each segment (personal notebook index plus enterprise indexes) instead of requiring a single personal FilePaths-only payload.
